lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct high-contrast vertical white stripes traversing the lateral torso; spacing is approximately equidistant with a slight increase in gap width between the posterior-most segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior stripe is an abbreviated dash terminating in the upper third of the torso; the second and tenth stripes exhibit fading at the ventral margin; the eighth and ninth stripes terminate and transition into spots at the lower haunch.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 8 high-contrast white spots is located on the lower haunch and upper hind limb, distal to the vertical stripe series.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron marking on the snout; distinct white spots on the cheek and jaw area; white transverse markings on the lower portions of all four limbs.
